disclosures.text: A vacuum gripper is portable or hand-held.
A rigid base element has a first side and a second side.
The second side of the base element has a central area and a periphery.
A loop-shaped vacuum seal element has an attachment surface.
The vacuum seal element is mounted to the periphery of the second side.
The vacuum seal element has a protruding portion free of contact with the base element.
The protruding portion extends along the entire attachment surface.
The protruding portion extends away from the first side of the base element.
The vacuum seal element has a contact surface as part of the protruding portion.
The contact surface is configured for at least partial contact with an object surface.
The vacuum seal element is elastically deformable at the contact surface.
The contact surface conforms to the object surface when pressed.
The vacuum seal element has an inner encircling surface facing the central area.
The vacuum seal element has an outer encircling surface facing away from the inner surface.
Both encircling surfaces extend between the contact and attachment surfaces.
A chamber is defined by the protruding portion and the central area.
An air extraction means is mounted to the first side of the base element.
The air extraction means is in fluid communication with the chamber through the base element.
The air extraction means continuously extracts air from the chamber.
Air extraction urges the contact surface towards and grips the object surface.
At least one bracing structure protrudes from the second side of the base element.
The bracing structure protrudes less than the vacuum seal element.
The bracing structure is made of a material more rigid than the vacuum seal element.
The bracing structure extends along a part of the periphery free of contact with the vacuum seal element.
The bracing structure material is less rigid than the base element material.

A portable or hand-held vacuum gripper comprises a rigid base element with a central area and periphery, a loop-shaped vacuum seal element with an attachment surface, a protruding portion, a contact surface, inner and outer encircling surfa
The periphery of the second side is bounded by a peripheral rim.
The periphery comprises a peripheral support area.
The attachment surface of the vacuum seal element is attached at the peripheral support area.
The peripheral support area constitutes a majority of the periphery.
At least a majority of the protruding portion is within a lateral boundary defined by the peripheral rim.
The vacuum seal element is mounted via a channel.
The channel receives an attachment portion of the vacuum seal element.
The attachment portion comprises the attachment surface.
The protruding portion protrudes from the channel along the entire extension of the attachment portion.
The channel width corresponds to the thickness of the attachment portion.
The channel depth corresponds to the height of the attachment portion.
The protruding portion protrudes from the channel along its entire width.
The channel width does not exceed the thickness of the protruding portion.
The contact surface is co-extensive with the channel along its entire width.
The peripheral rim constitutes one wall of the channel.
A handle for holding the vacuum gripper is connected to the first side of the base element.
The handle is connected at two spaced apart locations.
The handle comprises two integrally connected handle mounting sections.
The handle comprises a graspable handle section extending between the mounting sections.
The air extraction means includes a power source.
The power source is mounted at least partially within one handle mounting section.
The air extraction means comprises an impeller or a pump.
The air extraction mechanism is mounted within the handle.
Both the power source and air extraction mechanism are at least partially housed in the two handle mounting portions.
The bracing structure has a loop shape.
The protruding portion has a thickness between inner and outer encircling surfaces.
The thickness of the protruding portion is at least not smaller than the predetermined protrusion distance.
The vacuum seal element can be made of silicone, rubber, or closed-cell foam.
Closed-cell foam allows high compressibility, up to 75% of its thickness.
The air extraction means can be operated in a steady or variable manner.
The power source comprises a battery pack.
At least one of the power source and air extraction mechanism is disposed on the first side of the base element.
The handle extends along a longitudinal direction of the rigid base element.
The handle mounting sections are oriented transversely to the graspable section.
The air extraction means is housed in the handle assembly.
The bracing structure extends at least along a part of the protruding portion of the vacuum seal element.
The bracing structure has an intermittent shape.
The bracing structure is disposed closer to the central area than to a peripheral rim.
The bracing structure is disposed closer to the periphery than to the central area.
The bracing structure comprises at least one of rubber, silicone, and closed-cell foam.
The vacuum seal element is made at least partially of a closed-cell foam material.
